capture: GPU preserveDrawingBuffer=true explicitly; needed for capture after asynchronous completion.
measurement: Same 80 frames at fixed viewport. Frame includes two simulation ticks, snapshot, renderer submission, gl.finish and an asynchronous fenceSync/clientWaitSync completion check; excludes capture, PNG encoding and rAF. Fence wait includes task scheduling. Software SwiftShader, not hardware GPU FPS.
method: 21 catalog creatures, real attack commands against paired soldiers, 160 simulation ticks. Attack/idle/walk modes are observed, not forced. Cast coverage is reviewed separately in painter sheets.
